library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggpubr)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
#Load files
KV1.3.Brain.Background <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3.BRAIN.FEB1.25/KV1.3.Brain.Background.rds")

```{r GO Enrichment}
library(readxl)
 PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158 <- read_excel("PAP1-UP.VS.Shk-UP_158.xlsx")
PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158 <-  PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158$`PAP1-UP.VS.Shk-UP_158`
PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158 
##
 X_PAP1_Down_VS_Shk_Down_100 <- read_excel(" PAP1-Down.VS.Shk-Down_100.xlsx")
 PAP1_Down_VS_Shk_Down_100 <- X_PAP1_Down_VS_Shk_Down_100$`PAP1-Down.VS.Shk-Down_100`
 PAP1_Down_VS_Shk_Down_100
```

```{r GO Enrichment ANALYSIS}
#####Run Enrichment analysis code
go_up.PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158 <- enrichGO(
    gene         = PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158,
    universe     = KV1.3.Brain.Background,
    OrgDb        = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType      = "SYMBOL",
    ont          = "ALL",
    pAdjustMethod = "none",
    pvalueCutoff = 1, # Setting to 1 removes strict significance filtering
    qvalueCutoff = 1  # Setting to 1 removes strict significance filtering
)
go_up.PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158
# Convert to data frame
go_results <- as.data.frame(go_up.PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158)
# Convert GeneRatio (e.g., "5/100") into numeric values
go_results$GeneRatio_numeric <- sapply(go_results$GeneRatio, function(x) {
    eval(parse(text = x))  # Convert "5/100" to 0.05
})
# Compute Approximate NES (Z-score of GeneRatio)
go_results$NES <- (go_results$GeneRatio_numeric - mean(go_results$GeneRatio_numeric)) / 
                  sd(go_results$GeneRatio_numeric)

go_results$zscore <- go_results$NES
go_results.PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158 <- go_results
head (go_results.PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158, 3)
# Select top 14 GO terms
top_terms <- head(go_results.PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158, 14)
# Generate the plot
ggplot(top_terms, aes(x = reorder(Description, NES), y = NES, fill = NES)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
    labs(title = "GO: PAP1_UP_VS_Shk_UP_158", 
         x = "GO Term", 
         y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)") +
    theme_classic() +  # Use a clean theme
    theme(
        text = element_text(size = 16), # Increase overall text size
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14), # Increase axis tick label size
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Increase axis title size
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), # Bigger and centered title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14), # Increase legend text size
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold") # Increase legend title size
    )  # Correctly close the theme function here
```
